lines.zh: 我走一步，沙子下面响一声。
lines.en: Each step I take makes a sound beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩下去，地面比我软。
lines.en: I set four feet down and the ground is softer than I am.

lines.zh: 背上的岩壳晒了一天，很暖。
lines.en: The rock shell on my back is warm after a day in the sun.

lines.zh: 我沿着恶地的裂谷走，那里有铁。
lines.en: I walk the badland ravines; there is iron there.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在地上，划出一条沟。
lines.en: My tail drags the ground and cuts a furrow.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但我不会停。
lines.en: My pace is slow, yet I never halt.

lines.zh: 沙子灌进脚缝，走路会响。
lines.en: Sand fills my foot joints and rattles as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕开仙人掌，它们扎不进壳。
lines.en: I walk around the cacti; they cannot pierce my shell.

lines.zh: 一整天，我只走了两座山之间。
lines.en: In a whole day I cross only between two hills.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一块砂岩，没感觉。
lines.en: I crush a sandstone block and feel nothing.

lines.zh: 背上落了一层沙，像多长了一层。
lines.en: Sand settles on my back like a second hide.

lines.zh: 我朝有水汽的方向走，虽然我不喝。
lines.en: I walk toward the smell of water, though I do not drink.

lines.zh: 影子跟着我，它比我轻得多。
lines.en: My shadow follows me and is far lighter than I am.

lines.zh: 走路时我低着头，找地上的矿脉。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, looking for ore veins.

lines.zh: 我撞开一道崖壁，走过去。
lines.en: I shoulder through a cliff wall and keep walking.

lines.zh: 脚下的砂岩响，像踩碎饼干。
lines.en: The sandstone crunches underfoot like broken biscuit.

lines.zh: 我趴在阴影里，岩壳当屋顶。
lines.en: I lie in the shade with my shell as a roof.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一块石头，像嚼面包。
lines.en: I chew a stone as if it were bread.

lines.zh: 沙子在我背上堆成一个小小的丘。
lines.en: Sand piles into a small dune on my back.

lines.zh: 我的胃里存着上个月的铁矿。
lines.en: My stomach holds last month's iron ore.

lines.zh: 日头太毒，我把头埋进沙里。
lines.en: The sun is cruel, so I bury my head in the sand.

lines.zh: 有蜥蜴在我壳上晒太阳，随它。
lines.en: A lizard suns itself on my shell; let it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢反刍，铁味在嘴里化开。
lines.en: I chew slowly and the taste of iron melts in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，像风过洞窟。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, like wind through a cave.

lines.zh: 我在等石头被晒裂，好啃。
lines.en: I wait for stones to crack in the heat so I can eat them.

lines.zh: 这片恶地我熟，每块岩都认识。
lines.en: I know this badland; I know every rock.

lines.zh: 我磨牙，磨出一层石粉。
lines.en: I grind my teeth and produce a layer of stone dust.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹进我的耳孔，我甩头。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into my ear hole and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 一动不动时，我像一块真的岩石。
lines.en: When I hold still, I am a real boulder.

lines.zh: 我在数背上的裂缝，一共十一条。
lines.en: I count the cracks on my back; eleven in all.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在尾上，缩成一团。
lines.en: I rest my head on my tail and curl up.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹进我眼里，我不眨。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into my eyes; I do not blink.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁在反光，很香。
lines.en: The iron on you is shining, and it smells good.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子上的壳咔了一声。
lines.en: I raise my head and the shell at my neck clicks.

lines.zh: 那副护甲，是给我吃的吗？
lines.en: Is that armor for me to eat?

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我鼻子上，凉。
lines.en: Your shadow lands on my nose, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，但看得清你的甲。
lines.en: I cannot see you clearly, but I see your armor.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，像一根细铁棍。
lines.en: You stand there like a thin iron rod.

lines.zh: 我歪头，反光也跟着歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the reflection tilts with it.

lines.zh: 你手里那把镐，也是石头做的？
lines.en: Is that pick in your hand also made of stone?

lines.zh: 别动，你一动，光就晃。
lines.en: Do not move; when you move, the light wavers.

lines.zh: 我记住的不是你的脸，是你的甲。
lines.en: What I remember is not your face but your armor.

lines.zh: 你身上有我吃过的那种矿的味道。
lines.en: You smell of the ore I have eaten before.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，这表示我不打算撞你。
lines.en: I blink slowly; that means I will not charge you.

lines.zh: 这一下打在壳缝里，疼。
lines.en: That hit landed in a seam of my shell; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的岩壳掉了一小块。
lines.en: A small piece of my rock shell chips off.

lines.zh: 别打腿，腿上的壳最薄。
lines.en: Do not hit my legs; their shell is thinnest.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，沙子都震起来。
lines.en: I roar and the sand jumps.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，岩壳蹭着地。
lines.en: I back half a step, shell scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 血从壳下面流出来，很慢。
lines.en: Blood seeps from under the shell, slowly.

lines.zh: 这一击让我记起自己会疼。
lines.en: This blow reminds me that I can feel pain.

lines.zh: 你再打，我就滚过去。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will roll at you.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把身体缩紧。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and pull my body tight.

lines.zh: 伤口进了沙，磨得难受。
lines.en: Sand gets into the wound and grinds badly.

lines.zh: 那块铁的反光，正好照进我眼里。
lines.en: The glare of that iron shines right into my eye.

lines.zh: 你腰上的扣子，看起来能嚼。
lines.en: The buckle at your waist looks chewable.

lines.zh: 把护甲脱下来，放地上，退开。
lines.en: Take off the armor, set it down, and step back.

lines.zh: 我不吃人，我只吃你身上的铁。
lines.en: I do not eat people; I eat the iron on them.

lines.zh: 铁锈的味道让我走不动路。
lines.en: The smell of rust stops my legs.

lines.zh: 那面盾牌真圆，一定很脆。
lines.en: That shield is nicely round; it must be brittle.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁矿了，就在你脚边。
lines.en: I smell iron ore, right beside your feet.

lines.zh: 让我舔一下，就一下。
lines.en: One lick is all I ask.

lines.zh: 你走路时甲片相碰，像在叫我。
lines.en: Your plates clink as you walk, like a call to me.

lines.zh: 反射的光比火还勾人。
lines.en: Reflected light draws me more than fire.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴上去，先闻后咬。
lines.en: I press my nose to it, sniff first, bite later.

lines.zh: 这块金锭也成，我不挑。
lines.en: A gold ingot will do as well; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我的口水滴在沙上，冒了个泡。
lines.en: My drool drips onto the sand and bubbles.

lines.zh: 你要是不给，我就自己撞开。
lines.en: If you will not give it, I will break it open myself.

lines.zh: 你背包里的铁锭在响，我听见。
lines.en: The iron ingots in your pack are clinking. I hear them.

lines.zh: 把盾放下，我就只咬盾。
lines.en: Set the shield down and I will only bite the shield.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，你退了三步。
lines.en: I bump you and you take three steps back.

lines.zh: 我的岩壳硬，撞到会疼。
lines.en: My rock shell is hard; hitting it hurts.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我转身时看不见脚边。
lines.en: Sorry, I cannot see my feet when I turn.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的尾巴扫到你。
lines.en: You stood too close and my tail swept you.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，沙子扬了起来。
lines.en: We bump and the desert dust rises.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，沙里空出一个坑。
lines.en: I shuffle aside, leaving a hollow in the sand.

lines.zh: 别从后面碰我，那里壳最厚。
lines.en: Do not touch me from behind; the shell is thickest there.

lines.zh: 你推不动我，这不是你的错。
lines.en: You cannot push me; it is not your fault.

lines.zh: 我被你绊了一下，很没面子。
lines.en: You trip me up, which is embarrassing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走过去，尽量侧身。
lines.en: I pass beside you, turning as narrow as I can.

lines.zh: 我们用头轻轻碰壳，算打招呼。
lines.en: We greet each other by tapping shells lightly.

lines.zh: 她背上的岩壳有一道旧裂。
lines.en: Her rock shell has one old crack.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块铁矿推给她。
lines.en: I push the best lump of iron ore toward her.

lines.zh: 两只巨兽并排，地面在抖。
lines.en: Two great beasts side by side, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴缠在一起，像两条石脉。
lines.en: Our tails twine like two veins of stone.

lines.zh: 她在沙里刨了个坑，我守着。
lines.en: She digs a pit in the sand and I keep watch.

lines.zh: 幼崽的壳是软的，要养很久。
lines.en: The young have soft shells and need long care.

lines.zh: 我们分食一块含铁的砂岩。
lines.en: We share a slab of iron-bearing sandstone.

lines.zh: 她走得慢，我就走得更慢。
lines.en: She walks slowly, so I walk slower.

lines.zh: 分别时，我们各撞一下头。
lines.en: When we part, we knock our heads once.

lines.zh: 这块铁矿不错，我含着走。
lines.en: This iron ore is good; I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把矿车上的铁轨掰了一段。
lines.en: I snap a length of rail off the mine cart.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的剑，我当零食收着。
lines.en: The sword on the ground, I keep as a snack.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼，爪子太钝了。
lines.en: I carry things in my mouth; my claws are too blunt.

lines.zh: 这块砂岩太轻，我扔了。
lines.en: This sandstone is too light; I discard it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚铁锭，咽下去了。
lines.en: I pick up an iron ingot and swallow it.

lines.zh: 那口锅里还有铁，我舔干净。
lines.en: There is still iron in that pot; I lick it clean.

lines.zh: 我把一整副甲拖回洞里。
lines.en: I drag a whole set of armor back to my den.

lines.zh: 你掉的镐子，还你，不好吃。
lines.en: You dropped a pick; take it back, it tastes bad.

lines.zh: 我收集铁，也收集会反光的东西。
lines.en: I collect iron, and anything that shines.

lines.zh: 有东西在崖上敲石头，很吵。
lines.en: Something is knocking stone on the cliff; it is loud.

lines.zh: 那边有铁在动，我看见了。
lines.en: There is iron moving over there; I see it.

lines.zh: 狼群围过来了，它们咬不动壳。
lines.en: Wolves are closing in; they cannot bite through the shell.

lines.zh: 有人拿着镐，冲我的矿脉来了。
lines.en: Someone with a pick is coming for my ore vein.

lines.zh: 那副甲一直在反光，躲不掉。
lines.en: That armor keeps flashing; it cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把前脚压实。
lines.en: I lift my head and plant my forefeet.

lines.zh: 洞里的蝙蝠全飞出来了。
lines.en: The bats in the cave have all flown out.

lines.zh: 这声音我熟，是箭搭上弦。
lines.en: I know that sound; it is an arrow on a string.

lines.zh: 它比石头小，但比石头快。
lines.en: It is smaller than a rock but faster.

lines.zh: 我不常发怒，可我记性好。
lines.en: I do not often get angry, but I remember well.

lines.zh: 我盯住那身甲，别处都不看。
lines.en: I fix on that armor and nothing else.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我的头跟着转。
lines.en: It circles, and my head follows.

lines.zh: 我要撞的是它的膝盖，不是身体。
lines.en: I aim at its knee, not its body.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我后脚开始蹬沙。
lines.en: The distance is right; my hind feet dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 它以为壳厚的动物转不了身。
lines.en: It thinks a shelled animal cannot turn.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，尾巴收进腹下。
lines.en: I lower my head and tuck my tail beneath me.

lines.zh: 风从崖边吹来，我借它加速。
lines.en: Wind comes off the cliff and I borrow it for speed.

lines.zh: 它手里的东西太亮，晃我眼睛。
lines.en: What it holds is too bright and blinds me.

lines.zh: 我在等它先迈那一步。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to take that first step.

lines.zh: 沙在脚下滑，我要提前半秒动。
lines.en: Sand slides underfoot; I must move half a second early.

lines.zh: 头槌撞上去，崖壁碎了。
lines.en: My headbutt lands and the cliff face breaks.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在岩壁上，碾了一下。
lines.en: I pin it to the rock wall and grind.

lines.zh: 爪子按住，牙齿跟着来。
lines.en: My claw pins it down, and my teeth follow.

lines.zh: 这一撞，连我的壳都在响。
lines.en: With this blow even my own shell rings.

lines.zh: 它被撞飞，落进沙里。
lines.en: It is thrown and lands in the sand.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的甲，把甲片撕开。
lines.en: I bite its armor and tear a plate loose.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，扫倒了两个人。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and knocks two of them down.

lines.zh: 它的骨头比铁矿软多了。
lines.en: Its bones are far softer than iron ore.

lines.zh: 岩壳太重，撞完我得站一会儿。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; after a charge I must stand a while.

lines.zh: 我把碎掉的甲片捡起来吃。
lines.en: I pick up the broken armor plates and eat them.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘下钻出来，抖落一身沙。
lines.en: I emerge from under a dune and shake off the sand.

lines.zh: 岩壳一露出来，太阳就照上了。
lines.en: As my shell shows, the sun lands on it.

lines.zh: 这片恶地很大，够我走一辈子。
lines.en: This badland is large enough for a lifetime.

lines.zh: 我的第一顿是一块砂岩。
lines.en: My first meal was a slab of sandstone.

lines.zh: 风里有铁味，我朝那边去。
lines.en: There is iron in the wind; I head that way.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，先看清四周。
lines.en: I flatten my body and look around first.

lines.zh: 崖壁上有旧的撞痕，不是我留的。
lines.en: There are old impact marks on the cliff, not mine.

lines.zh: 沙下面有东西在动，我踩住它。
lines.en: Something moves under the sand; I step on it.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，喷出两团沙。
lines.en: I snort and blow out two puffs of sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，地面陷了半寸。
lines.en: I rise slowly and the ground sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 火烤在壳上，我闻到石头热了的味。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I smell hot stone.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下，壳替我受了。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff and my shell takes it.

lines.zh: 我不该下水，壳太重了。
lines.en: I should not have entered the water; the shell is too heavy.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我推得滚了半圈。
lines.en: The blast wave rolls me half a turn.

lines.zh: 箭打在壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shell and bounces off.

lines.zh: 有什么在我壳下面爬，凉的。
lines.en: Something crawls under my shell, cold.

lines.zh: 没有铁，我只能嚼沙子。
lines.en: With no iron, I can only chew sand.

lines.zh: 雷劈在岩壳上，麻到脚趾。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and numbs me to the toes.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我的壳没有用。
lines.en: There is no ground under me, and my shell is useless.
